assumptions: 25 numbers uniformly shuffled without replacement; batches 3,2,1,1,1; current board generator and 12% chance round; excludes sugar/JPC value and medal rounding
status: Exploratory only. No payout or initial-board changes applied. Independent larger sample and sugar/JPC valuation required.
calibrationConstraint: All nonzero payout values must be multiples of 0.1 BET; do not use the uniform half-payout proposal because line would be 0.05.
